text: A benchtop rig built from grey aluminium extrusion profiles, mounted on a light grey work surface. In the centre-left, a dark grey/black plastic rack with a row of circular holes (roughly six or seven openings, all empty) sits horizontally in the frame; a small white label with a logo is attached to the extrusion below it. At upper centre, a blue vacuum pump with a black motor housing and a silver-capped port stands upright; a black cable runs from it down and to the right. On the right, vertical aluminium plates with visible bolt heads support a dark screen or display panel, angled toward the viewer. At left, white plastic plates or panels lie flat on the bench. No liquids or containers are visible.
